description: Fetch one account group by id, name, or default flag. Returns the group's connectionIds[] so they can be passed straight to create_post. Name matching is case-insensitive (exact match preferred, substring fallback). If the name is ambiguous the server returns 300 with the candidates.

default.description: When true, fetch the team's default group and ignore idOrName.

idOrName.description: Mongo ObjectId or group name (e.g. 'Polish Pages'). Omit when using default=true.

name: get_account_group
